sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town at home on Saturday. After a recent loss, Sandbach will be looking to bounce back against bottom-of-the-table Alsager, who have won just once all season and arrive in poor form with one win in their last five.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture that could have title-race implications, with both sides capable of closing the gap on Sandbach. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth face a home clash against Eccleshall in sixth—a strong encounter between two of the division's better-performing sides. Wolverhampton Casuals host Wednesfield Community in a local derby, with the visitors seeking to arrest a recent dip in form. Bilston Town visit Foley Meir as part of the upper-mid-table tussle. In the basement, Widnes Town travel to Brereton Social in a clash between struggling sides, while Cheadle Heath Nomads host Telford Town and Market Drayton Town welcome New Mills as other lower-table contests. Crewe face Allscott Heath and Shawbury United play at home to Barnton, completing the weekend's full fixture list.
